body:
Most intense and informative journey ever taken. Definitely a dissociative.
In small 1 gram to 3 gram doses it is highly stimulating.
I am bipolar and find it helpful for flattening out at small doses while giving me extra endurance. I will never be unfaithful to this spirit.
I have virtually done it all, and this one experience exposed me to all the suffering of the world. I felt the enormous capacity to bear it in an actual physical way (a psychic physicality) and all my self hate was exposed for what it is. I understood the toxicity of shame that was imposed on me in a detached and abstract way, but this threw me into the pool of all suffering, and while terror struck all I felt was joy and thanks. I just let it go go go, and then decided to make a turn and watch the wonderful galaxy before me shifting between subatomic space.
Most intense psychedelic ever. Definitely not recreational, but similar in effect to ket and mexy.
Except, this drug is so easy to titrate and produce the effect I desire (to me, all of them pleasant).
Highest heights and deepest depths, tumult of chaos and secret breath.
